source.author: ov
source.text: Exsiluit iunctasque manus pavefacta remisit diva potens uteri: vinclis levor ipsa remissis.
source.text_original: Exsiluit iunctasque manus pavefacta remisit / diva potens uteri: vinclis levor ipsa remissis.
source.text_english: The powerful goddess of the womb leaped up and, frightened, withdrew her joined hands: I am eased, now that my bonds have been loosened.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: magnanimus spectat pharetras et inutile robur Amphitryoniades; miscent suprema paventes verba alii iunguntque manus atque ora fatigant aspectu in misero toti, cum protinus alnus solvitur et vasto puppis mare sorbet hiatu.
reuse.text_original: magnanimus spectat pharetras et inutile robur / Amphitryoniades; miscent suprema paventes / verba alii iunguntque manus atque ora fatigant / aspectu in misero toti, cum protinus alnus / solvitur et vasto puppis mare sorbet hiatu.
reuse.text_english: The great-souled son of Amphitryon looks on at the quivers and useless strength; others, fearing their last moments, utter their final words and join hands and weary their faces with one another’s sight in their misery, while straightway the ship is unfastened and, with a vast gape, the sea swallows it whole.
